97ggNQ2Zg923CL4wNf6COg.zh: 烏克蘭文察州(Vinnytsia Oblast)報告1例感染Ib型之成年男性病例,具歐洲旅遊史,病況輕微,目前已實施隔離,並針對接觸者進行21天健康監測,迄無新增病例。該國目前無本土傳播疫情,惟仍須嚴防來自其他歐洲國家之境外移入風險。 安哥拉卡賓達省(Cabinda)疫情由2024-25年之零星病例轉為持續社區傳播,目前爆發Ib型疫情。該國今年截至9/8累計264例確定病例,其中38例住院、2例死亡。個案以20-29歲(52%)及女性(66%)為主,多無旅遊史,主要經身體與性接觸傳播。當局已調撥3萬劑疫苗,針對醫護人員與高風險區⺠眾展開緊急接種防護。
97ggNQ2Zg923CL4wNf6COg.en: In Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine, one adult male infected with clade Ib, with a history of travel in Europe, has been reported; the case is mild. The patient has been isolated, and contacts are under 21 days of health monitoring; no new cases have been found. Ukraine currently has no local transmission, but must still guard strictly against imported cases from other European countries. In Cabinda Province, Angola, the outbreak has shifted from sporadic cases in 2024–25 to sustained community transmission, and a clade Ib outbreak is now under way. The country has reported 264 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 8 September, including 38 hospitalised and 2 deaths. Cases are mainly aged 20–29 (52%) and female (66%), most without travel history, and transmission is mainly through physical and sexual contact. Authorities have allocated 30,000 doses of vaccine for emergency vaccination of health workers and residents in high-risk areas.

iQ1_Wxrj9opk99ILDnQrxA.zh: 烏克蘭利維夫州(Lviv Regional)於7/23公佈首例確定病例,為53 歲男性, 其於7/12出現發燒、頭痛等症狀,7/15住院,經PCR確診為漢他病毒引起之腎綜合症出血熱。發病前曾前往克羅埃西亞,感染源不明。該國今年迄累計3例確定病例,已在患者住家當地加強防疫及預防措施 。
iQ1_Wxrj9opk99ILDnQrxA.en: On 23 July, Lviv Region in Ukraine announced its first confirmed case, a 53-year-old man who developed fever and headache on 12 July and was hospitalized on 15 July. PCR confirmed hantavirus-caused haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. He had travelled to Croatia before onset, and the source of infection is unknown. This year, the country has reported 3 confirmed cases cumulatively. Prevention and control measures have been strengthened in the patient's home area.

_gVI8V4kgafkkdRP2CYQhQ.zh: 烏克蘭自2022-26年累計報告6例死亡病例,2021-24年確診病例數亦自780例上升至2,507例,動物感染數亦逐年攀升;近期研究顯示因受戰爭影響,未接種疫苗的流浪動物(包括野生動物)數量增加,且活動環境擴張。此外,原由家庭飼養之寵物亦遭棄養而流落街頭,進一步增加人畜接觸與傳播風險。
_gVI8V4kgafkkdRP2CYQhQ.en: Ukraine has reported 6 rabies deaths cumulatively from 2022 to 2026. Confirmed case numbers for 2021–24 also rose from 780 to 2,507, and animal infections have risen year by year. Recent research shows that, due to the war, the number of unvaccinated stray animals, including wildlife, has increased and their range of activity has expanded. In addition, pets once kept at home have been abandoned and left on the streets, further increasing the risk of human-animal contact and transmission.

uZXRNcj7jpzRwy0O9PPBfw.zh: 烏克蘭8月報告1,084例病例,其中195例為抗藥性結核;研究發現東部地區自2022年後,發生率顯著下降,顯示於戰爭衝突下,不易維持監測通報系統之運作。
uZXRNcj7jpzRwy0O9PPBfw.en: Ukraine reported 1,084 cases in August, of which 195 were drug-resistant tuberculosis. A study found that incidence in the eastern region has declined significantly since 2022, indicating that under armed conflict it is difficult to maintain the operation of surveillance and notification systems.

Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/15報告14起疫情,累計31州1,024例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多;加拿大今年截至5/3共7省1,846例,以安大略省(1,460)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告1,300餘例。 烏克蘭疫情上升,今年至3月報告472例,較去(2024)年增加20.5倍,並報告2例兒童死亡,病例集中於西部地區之外喀爾巴阡/車夫契/敖得薩州,由於當地戰事持續使公共衛生服務受到干擾,降低疫苗接種率,且人口流動加劇疾病傳播風險。
Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.en: North America update: as of 15 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,024 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. As of 3 May, Canada had 1,846 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,460), and case numbers in Alberta have also risen rapidly. In northern Mexico, the outbreak in Chihuahua State is severe, with more than 1,300 cases reported so far this year. Ukraine's outbreak is rising: 472 cases were reported through March this year, a 20.5-fold increase compared with last year, and 2 child deaths have been reported. Cases are concentrated in the western oblasts of Zakarpattia, Chernivtsi and Odesa. Ongoing conflict in the area is disrupting public health services and lowering vaccination rates, and population movement is increasing the risk of spread.

OI3OEubWCIyOGuW-7kb2sQ.zh: 烏克蘭首都基輔於5/13報告34例病例,其中有20例為兒童,當局已進行調查,以確定導致感染傳播的來源和因素,受疫情影響的學校已改為遠距教學。
OI3OEubWCIyOGuW-7kb2sQ.en: The Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, reported 34 cases on 13 May, 20 of them children. Authorities are investigating to determine the source and factors behind the spread of infection, and schools affected by the outbreak have switched to distance learning.

maWq8YafMCSzfZ3z2_vmPw.zh: 瑞典2024年累計報告1,612例病例,為近14年來新高,病患年齡中位數為42歲,檢出型別多為腸道沙門氏菌及傷寒沙門氏菌;經調查生產自烏克蘭之雞蛋及義大利之苜蓿芽為造成當年大規模疫情的主因,各造成逾百人之感染,另境外輸入病例多來自泰國。
maWq8YafMCSzfZ3z2_vmPw.en: Sweden reported 1,612 cases cumulatively in 2024, the highest in nearly 14 years, with a median patient age of 42. The types detected were mainly Salmonella enterica and Salmonella Typhi. Investigation found that eggs produced in Ukraine and alfalfa sprouts from Italy were the main causes of large-scale outbreaks that year, each infecting more than 100 people. Imported cases mainly came from Thailand.

dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.zh: 南亞越南今年疫情驟升,截至12/21累計報告近5千例病例,已逾去年病例數百倍,分布以胡志明市佔1,800例最多,目前疫情仍持續,近期北部省份疫情亦有上升趨勢,研判此波疫情為自然疾病週期和低疫苗接種率之結果;柬埔寨今年疫情亦上升,截至12/22累計17省報告375例病例,當局呼籲家長確保孩童接種疫苗。 北美加拿大安大略省今年截至12/18累計報告63例病例,較去年之7例大幅上升,其中1例死亡,病患中有37例與新布藍茲維省麻疹群聚事件有關,多數病例未接種疫苗。 東歐烏克蘭今年截至11月累計報告333例病例,為去年同期之6倍,近期西南部車夫契州疫情上升,當局表示已在控制之中,惟仍呼籲兒童及孕婦接種疫苗。 北非摩洛哥北部丹吉爾-得土安-胡塞馬大區近期疫情上升,已知謝夫沙萬省及得土安省已分別報告50及70例病例,並有至少3例兒童死亡案例。
dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.en: In South-East Asia, Viet Nam's measles outbreak has surged this year: as of 21 December, nearly 5,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than a hundredfold increase over last year's total. Ho Chi Minh City accounts for the largest share, with 1,800 cases. The outbreak is still ongoing, and case numbers have recently been rising in northern provinces too. Authorities attribute this wave to the natural disease cycle and low vaccination coverage. In Cambodia, cases have also risen this year: as of 22 December, 375 cases had been reported cumulatively across 17 provinces, and authorities urge parents to make sure their children are vaccinated. In North America, Ontario, Canada, reported 63 cases cumulatively as of 18 December this year, sharply up from 7 cases last year; one patient died. Of these cases, 37 were linked to the measles cluster in New Brunswick Province, and most cases were unvaccinated. In Eastern Europe, Ukraine reported 333 cases cumulatively as of November this year, six times the same period last year. Cases have recently risen in the south-western Chernivtsi Oblast; authorities say the situation is under control but still urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. In North Africa, cases have risen recently in the Tangier-Tétouan-Al Hoceima region of northern Morocco. Chefchaouen and Tétouan provinces have reported 50 and 70 cases respectively, and at least three child deaths have occurred.
